# Immutable Foundry revision-one baseline

Exact pre-gantry JSON and source/test bytes are bound by SHA256SUMS.txt. Historical
source is kept as text to avoid adding editor indexing/preload-graph work.
Do not rewrite these bytes or expected hashes to bless revision2.

Revision2 adds an actual three-cell-wide casting gantry between the vertebral
furnace east approach and the central circulation spine. Its west ramp rises
0→4m over16m; upper casting landing spans x13–15; east ramp descends4→2m over8m.
The original low furnace/north return and lower junction remain alternative
routes. The authored furnace loop uses the new crossing; all hero, actor,
pickup, interaction, door, encounter and scenery records remain unchanged.

Runtime floors_v1.FOUNDRY retains only immutable terrain fields for true1→2
save migration. Version0 uses floors_v0 rather than being confused with1.
Source math, native codec, role navigation and actual Player traversal are
separate tests; none establishes earned seal orders, combat, final art quality,
physical input, GPU performance or standalone-release acceptance.
